def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    units_sold = 50000
    purchase_costs = [
        (40000, 17),  # 1/23 purchase
        (30000, 15),  # 1/20 purchase
        (20000, 13),  # Beginning inventory
    ]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer using LIFO
    units_remaining = units_sold
    cost_of_goods_sold = 0

    for units, cost_per_unit in purchase_costs:
        units_used = min(units_remaining, units)
        cost_of_goods_sold += units_used * cost_per_unit
        units_remaining -= units_used

        if units_remaining == 0:
            break

    # Return answer to the nearest dollar
    return round(cost_of_goods_sold)
